data.name: Intimidating Prowess (Mythic)
data.description: Your mythic stature makes others uneasy.

raw_tokens.value: Your mythic stature makes others uneasy.

You gain a +%1 bonus on Intimidate checks against non-mythic creatures, or +%2 against mythic creatures. If you also have the Persuasive (mythic) feat, you can expend one use of mythic power to treat the Intimidate check as if you had rolled a natural 20. You must decide to use this ability before the roll is made.|MythicLevel|HalfMythicLevel
